headline: Your website is healthy and easier to find.
summary: In June we rewrote nine page titles for search, fixed the reviews layout on phones and removed two old hosting accounts.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Page titles rewritten for search
improvements.body: Nine pages have clearer titles and descriptions in Google results.

improvements.title: Reviews fit on small screens
improvements.body: Long reviews ran off the edge on phones. They now wrap neatly.

improvements.title: Old hosting accounts removed
improvements.body: Two accounts that no longer needed access to the hosting were removed.

improvements.title: Monthly backup verified
improvements.body: This month's backup was restored on a test copy and checked page by page.

nextMonth: Check the contact form reaches both inboxes
